name: online_retail_ii
note: Real transaction stream of ONE UK online gift-ware retailer, Dec 2009 - Dec 2011. Informs within-merchant amount dispersion, hour-of-day and weekday seasonality, daily volume and its over-dispersion, repeat-payer structure and the return/cancellation rate. Cannot inform chargeback rate, fraud prevalence, cross-category amount levels, or anything about latent risk states.
